name: Soldier 0 - Anby

description.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

description.name: Basic Attack: Penetrating Shock
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
On the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, enemies are continuously pulled in.
After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

description.name: Dodge: Strobe
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Torrent
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Ground Flash Counter
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> will immediately cancel the current skill and launch <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color>.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Celestial Thunder
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash
description.desc:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color> mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> to trigger an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> that deals 1 extra instance of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Thunder Smite
description.desc:
When the additional damage from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.

description.name: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary
description.desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Thunder Smite</color> DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary</color> will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This skill counts as an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt
description.desc:
With enough energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Chain Attack: Leaping Thunderstrike
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Voidstrike
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Quick Assist: Cloud Flash
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Counter Surge
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Conducting Blow
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Static Charge
1.desc: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> 3 times. This effect does not consume any <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> stacks.
1.desc2:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

2.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
2.desc:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 6 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> (max 6 stacks). With <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color>, when using <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Azure Flash</color> to hit an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>, it will consume 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> instead. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> will still activate the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Thunder's Cry</color> consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
2.desc2:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

3.name: Past Glory
3.desc2:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

4.name: Silver Reverb
4.desc: When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Silver Star</color>, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
4.desc2:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

5.name: Director's Cut
5.desc2:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

6.name: Prequel Protagonist
6.desc: Upon triggering 6 instances of <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color>'s additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
6.desc2:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

3113810.name: Soldier 0 - Anby: Silver Soldier
3113810.desc:
Anby's old Silver Squad uniform, stained with memories that never truly fade.
When the shadows of the past strike without warning, would you stand and face them, or stumble and flee? No matter the choice, home always awaits your return.
